atoms.name: Minimax value
atoms.one_line: MAX nodes take the largest child value, MIN nodes the smallest; the root move is the child with the best value.

atoms.name: Minimax properties
atoms.one_line: Complete on finite trees, optimal against an optimal opponent, time $O(b^m)$, space $O(bm)$.

atoms.name: Alpha and beta
atoms.one_line: $\alpha$ = highest value MAX can already guarantee on the path; $\beta$ = lowest value MIN can already guarantee. Prune when $\alpha\ge\beta$.

atoms.name: Tracing alpha-beta
atoms.one_line: Pass $(\alpha,\beta)$ down, update on the way up, mark subtrees skipped when $\alpha\ge\beta$.

atoms.name: Move ordering and effect
atoms.one_line: Root value never changes; best ordering gives $O(b^{m/2})$, worst gives no pruning.

atoms.name: Pruning conditions with unknown leaves
atoms.one_line: A leaf $x$ gives an inequality against the current $\alpha$ or $\beta$: solve it for the range.

atoms.name: Expectimax
atoms.one_line: Chance nodes take the probability-weighted average; max nodes take the maximum.
